source: docs/design/33-crypto.md, Testing: published vectors for the crypto backends. NIST/GCM spec (AES-256-GCM), RFC 5869 (HKDF), RFC 8032 (Ed25519), RFC 7748 (X25519), RFC 6979 A.2.5 (P-256 key and signature), the CFRG's RFC 9180 test-vectors.json (HPKE base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM and AES-256-GCM), and a Wycheproof subset (testvectors_v1, 0.9rc5): AES-GCM with 256-bit keys and 96-bit nonces, X25519 valid and low-order cases, Ed25519 valid and invalid, ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 P1363 (40 valid, every invalid), HKDF-SHA256 (40). Key formats and JOSE (crypto-key-formats, jwt): Wycheproof RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 and RSASSA-PSS (2048-bit, SHA-256, MGF1, 32-byte salt; every valid and invalid case, with each group's PEM and JWK), json_web_signature (HS256, ES256, RS256, PS256 and the RFC 7520 groups; not tcId 17, the JSON serialization, 372-373, which a strict base64url decoder refuses, 367 and 370, whose token is the valid one, or valid tokens of other algorithms, such as RFC 7520's PS384), json_web_key (the public-key sets and HS256 key sizes; not the ROCA key), x25519_jwk and x25519_pem (40 valid, every invalid); RFC 8037 A.1-A.5 and RFC 7515 A.1-A.3.
